# Profinity 2.3 documentation, full page list

> Every page of the Profinity 2.3 documentation with a one-line description. Generated from page front matter by scripts/generate-llms-txt.js. For a short index, see /llms.txt.

## Getting Started

- [Getting started with Profinity](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/index.html): Start here to install Profinity, create a user, load a profile, add components and see your data on a dashboard.
- [Adding Components to Your Profile](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/Adding_New_Components.html): Add components like hardware devices and protocol adapters to your Profinity profile by using the dashboard interface.
- [Create a user](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/Create_User.html): Create a Profinity user, set an initial password and assign roles so the person can sign in with the access they need.
- [Profinity Profiles](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/Profiles.html): Understand how Profinity profiles organise system configuration, components, dashboards, and settings for different setups.
- [Profinity System Logs](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/Profinity_Log.html): Access Profinity's built-in system logs to view timestamped entries with message levels for troubleshooting and issue diagnosis.
- [Quick Start Guide](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/Quick_Start.html): Get started with Profinity 2.3 by installing on Windows or Linux, applying a licence, loading an example profile, replaying CAN logs, editing your first dashboard and looking at rules and alerts.
- [Visualising Data](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/Visualising_Data.html): Visualise component data using Profinity's built-in dashboards that display relevant information for each configured component.

## Installation

- [Installing Profinity](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/index.html): Choose how to install Profinity on Windows, Linux, macOS, or Docker, then apply a licence, set environment variables and run it as a service.
- [Applying a Licence](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Applying_a_Licence.html): Apply a Profinity licence file after installation, from the License page or by copying it into the licence folder, and check that it has taken effect.
- [Artefacts Directory](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Artifacts_Directory.html): Understand where Profinity stores configuration, profiles, plugins, and logs in the artefacts directory on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [Docker Installation](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Docker_Installation.html): Install and run Profinity in Docker containers, update the image, and use environment variables for production deployments.
- [Environment variables](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Environment_Variables.html): Set Profinity configuration and profile values from environment variables, with the placeholder syntax and setup for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Docker.
- [Migration from V1 to V2](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Migration.html): Understand the key differences and recommended approach for migrating from Profinity V1 to V2, which requires clean installation.
- [Running Profinity as a Service or Daemon](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Running_As_Service.html): Configure Profinity to run as a system service on Linux, macOS, or Windows with automatic startup and failure recovery.
- [Security Guide](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Security.html): Implement essential security controls for Profinity production deployments including HTTPS, user accounts, scripting, and kiosk mode.
- [Windows Installation](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Windows_Installation.html): Install Profinity on Windows using the Setup Wizard MSI installer for desktop application or web browser access.
- [Linux and macOS Installation](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Zip_Installation.html): Install Profinity on Linux and macOS with the bootstrap installer, or from a downloaded archive, and start it with the profinity.sh startup script.

## Administration

- [Administering Profinity](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/index.html): Administer a running Profinity: system settings, users, and roles, profiles, licensing, logs, and the plugins and component types engineers can use.
- [System Configuration](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/index.html): Every tab of the Profinity System Configuration page: application, logging, discovery, web, extensions web, tags, security, and AI settings.
- [Security](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Security/index.html): The instance-wide authentication and access policy on the System Configuration Security tab, including sign-in method, session policy and login lockout.
- [Users and access](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Users_and_Access/index.html): Manage who can sign in to Profinity and what they can do: user accounts, roles, service accounts, multi-factor authentication, and security restrictions.
- [Components & Plugins](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Components_and_Plugins.html): Install and manage plugins, and choose which component types engineers can add to a Profile, from Components & Plugins in the admin UI.
- [Feedback](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Feedback.html): Built-in feedback system for sharing suggestions, reporting issues, and providing user experience feedback.
- [Kiosk Mode](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Kiosk_Mode.html): Configure automatic sign-in for kiosk displays and unattended monitoring stations, bypassing the login page for a specific profile.
- [Licensing](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Licensing.html): Manage Profinity licensing with offline signed licence files, check feature entitlements, and configure trial licences.
- [Logs](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Logs_Config.html): Configure Profinity system logging levels, log file rollover settings, and retention policies for diagnostics.
- [Menu Layout](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Menu_Layout.html): Arrange the components and groups in the top section of the side menu using the Menu Layout editor.
- [Profile Dashboard](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Profile_Dashboard.html): Create custom home page dashboards for profiles with the dashboard visual editor, with YAML upload as an alternative.
- [Profiles](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Profiles.html): Create and manage profiles to organise device configurations, with support for kiosk mode and custom dashboards.
- [Profinity AI Settings](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/AI_Settings.html): Configure the instance-wide Profinity AI assistant with external providers or local models for live data queries.
- [Application Config](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Application_Config.html): Packet retention, update checks, the recent tag history window and scripting on the System Configuration Application Config tab.
- [Discovery](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Discovery.html): Configure the LAN heartbeat that lets Profinity Mobile find this Profinity server.
- [Extensions Web](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Extensions_Web.html): Configure the second web server that hosts custom applications and the Profinity API.
- [Logging](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Logging.html): Set the log level, log rollover size and number of retained logs on the System Configuration Logging tab.
- [Profinity Web](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Profinity_Web.html): Configure the main Profinity HTTP and HTTPS web server and its certificates.
- [Password Policy](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Security/Password_Policy.html): Set password length, complexity and expiry rules for local sign-in, force password changes and let users change their own password.
- [SCIM and SIEM](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Security/SCIM_and_SIEM.html): Enable SCIM user provisioning from identity providers and configure SIEM export of security audit events.
- [SSO and Sign-In Method](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Security/SSO_and_Sign_In.html): Choose the site-wide sign-in method and configure OpenID Connect single sign-on for all Profinity users.
- [Two-Factor Authentication](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Security/Two_Factor_Authentication.html): Require time-based one-time password (TOTP) two-factor authentication for local users, set recovery code and device trust policy, and allow security-key sign-in.
- [Tags](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Configuration/Tags.html): Limits for the in-memory tag history buffer on the System Configuration Tags tab.
- [System Information](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/System_Info.html): View Profinity version, licence summary, and software credits from the System Information page.
- [Component and Collection Security](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Users_and_Access/Component_And_Collection_Security.html): Control which users can see profile components and tag collections through role-based security restrictions.
- [Managing Users](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Users_and_Access/Manage_Users.html): Create user accounts, give each person the roles they need, and find the password and two-factor settings that apply to them.
- [MFA Account Management](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Users_and_Access/MFA_Account_Management.html): Reset a user's multi-factor authentication or password as an administrator, and manage your own authenticator from the ADMIN page.
- [Roles and Permissions](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Users_and_Access/Roles_and_Permissions.html): Control what each person can see and do in Profinity by creating roles and assigning them to users.
- [Service Accounts](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Users_and_Access/Service_Accounts.html): Create service accounts with API tokens that never expire, for automation and external Model Context Protocol (MCP) client access.

## Components

- [Prohelion Battery Management Systems](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Battery_Management_Systems/index.html): Monitor and manage Prohelion battery management systems including BMU and CMU data, configuration, and firmware.
- [CAN bus adapters](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/CAN_Bus_Protocols/index.html): Connect Profinity to a CAN bus with a CAN to Ethernet bridge, Peak USB, SocketCAN, SocketCANd, or Ewert CANdapter, or relay traffic with a virtual adapter.
- [Chargers and Power Supplies](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Chargers_and_Power/index.html): Charge a battery pack from Profinity using a TDK or Siglent programmable power supply or an Elcon charger, including settings, the charging screen and troubleshooting.
- [Prohelion Cloud Dashboard](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Cloud_Dashboard/index.html): Send Profinity tag values to the Prohelion Cloud platform with the Prohelion Cloud Dashboard component, including settings, licensing and network requirements.
- [Using a Custom Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Custom_Components/index.html): Add a device Profinity does not already ship by placing a Custom Component in a profile, with an optional DBC file, dashboard, and scripts.
- [Dashboard Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Dashboard/index.html): A built-in profile component that renders a dashboard defined in YAML and bound to existing tags, with no DBC file.
- [Historians](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Historians/index.html): Historian components store tag history in a database and allow it to be read back through the APIs.
- [Industrial Protocols](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Industrial_Protocols/index.html): Overview of Profinity's industrial protocol plugins: BACnet, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, OPC UA, and S7.
- [Loggers](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Loggers/index.html): Choose a Profinity logger to write tag collections or CAN messages to files, an SFTP server, InfluxDB v1 or Prometheus.
- [Motor Controller (WaveSculptor)](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Motor_Controller/index.html): Monitor and configure Prohelion WaveSculptor22 motor controllers with real-time performance, limit, error and temperature data.
- [Elmar Solar MPPT](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/MPPT/index.html): Monitor Elmar Solar maximum power point tracker efficiency, input/output voltage, and status events.
- [Publishers and Subscribers](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Publishers_and_Subscribers/index.html): Publish profile tag collections to MQTT brokers or web services, or subscribe to external Sparkplug B sources, and choose between a publisher, a logger and a Tag Relay.
- [Tag Relays](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Tag_Relays/index.html): Tag Relay Sender and Tag Relay Receiver components, which share live tags between Profinity instances.
- [CAN Bus Adapters](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/CAN_Bus_Protocols/CAN_Bus_Adapters.html): Add and configure CAN bus adapters including Prohelion and Tritium CAN to Ethernet bridges, Peak USB, SocketCAN, SocketCANd and Ewert Energy CANdapter.
- [Prohelion Virtual CAN Bus Adapter](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/CAN_Bus_Protocols/Virtual_CAN_Adapter.html): Use a virtual CAN adapter to relay traffic between CAN devices and provide protocol bridging.
- [Connections and Reconnecting](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Connections_and_Reconnecting.html): How components that connect to a broker, device, server or database start, show a problem, and recover.
- [InfluxDB v2 Historian](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Historians/InfluxDB_v2_Historian.html): Record tag history to an InfluxDB v2 server and read it back through the APIs.
- [InfluxDB v3 Historian](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Historians/InfluxDB_v3_Historian.html): Record tag history to an InfluxDB v3 server and read it back through the APIs.
- [TAG SQL Historian](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Historians/TAG_SQL_Historian.html): Record tag history to a SQL database and read it back through the APIs.
- [BACnet](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Industrial_Protocols/BACnet.html): Configure the BACnet Device component to poll BACnet/IP object present-values from a building automation device into Profinity tags.
- [EtherNet/IP](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Industrial_Protocols/EtherNet_IP.html): Configure the EtherNet/IP PLC component to poll Allen-Bradley CIP tags into Profinity tags.
- [Modbus](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Industrial_Protocols/Modbus.html): Configure the Modbus Device component to poll coils and registers from a Modbus TCP or RTU slave into Profinity tags.
- [OPC UA](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Industrial_Protocols/OPC_UA.html): Configure the OPC UA Client to poll NodeIds into Profinity tags, and the OPC UA Server to expose Profinity's tag tree as a read-only address space.
- [S7](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Industrial_Protocols/S7.html): Configure the S7 PLC component to poll Siemens S7 data blocks, memory, inputs and outputs into Profinity tags.
- [File and Tag Loggers](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Loggers/File_Loggers.html): Log CAN bus messages or tag collection values to local files or a remote SFTP server, with compression and archival options.
- [InfluxDB and Prometheus Logging](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Loggers/InfluxDB_Prometheus_Logger.html): Log tag collection values to InfluxDB v1 with the InfluxDB v1 Logger, or serve them to Prometheus with the Prometheus Logger.
- [MQTT Publisher](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Publishers_and_Subscribers/MQTT_Publisher.html): Publish profile tag collections to MQTT brokers in JSON or Sparkplug B format on interval or change.
- [MQTT Subscriber](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Publishers_and_Subscribers/MQTT_Subscriber.html): Subscribe to external Sparkplug B sources via MQTT and write incoming metrics into the profile tag tree.
- [Webhook Publisher](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Publishers_and_Subscribers/Webhook_Publisher.html): Push profile tag collections to HTTP endpoints via POST with JSON payloads on interval or change.
- [Tag Relay Receiver](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Tag_Relays/Tag_Relay_Receiver.html): Receive tags from remote Profinity instances and mount them as read-only tags under a per-site prefix.
- [Tag Relay Sender](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Components/Tag_Relays/Tag_Relay_Sender.html): Publish a snapshot of selected tag collections to a remote Profinity instance over HTTPS or MQTT.

## Tags

- [Tags](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/index.html): Profinity's tag catalogue foundation for Tag Explorer, collections, rules, and alerts.
- [Actions](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Actions.html): Choose and configure the built-in, Email, Slack, Webhook, MQTT and Run On Alert script actions that run when a tag rule fires.
- [Alerts Log](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Alerts.html): View, acknowledge and silence rule-generated alerts in the Alerts Log, with active and history tabs and live alert indicators.
- [Collections](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Collections.html): Group tags for filtering, dashboards, and rules using the visual editor and membership expressions.
- [Derived Tags](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Derived_Tags.html): Virtual tags computed automatically from expressions or scripts that behave like real tags.
- [Log / Replay Tags](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Logging_Replaying_Tags.html): Record tag values to files and replay recorded tag logs with playback controls and looping.
- [Rules](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Rules.html): Write tag rules in rules.yaml or the visual editor, set alert levels and thresholds, and attach actions that run when a rule fires.
- [Script-Driven Derived Tags](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Script_Driven_Derived_Tags.html): Compute derived tags with a script when one expression is not enough, including multi-step logic, state and several output tags.
- [Tag Expressions](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Tag_Expressions.html): Expression language for collections, rules, and derived tags to filter and compute tag values.
- [Tag Linking](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Tag_Linking.html): Tag Explorer context menu flows to quickly create collections, rules, and dashboard bindings.
- [Tag Relay](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Tag_Relay.html): Share live tags between Profinity instances using sender and receiver roles, with a choice of transport and per-site tag prefixes.
- [Tag Tree Path](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Tags/Tag_Tree_Path.html): Mount components at nested locations in the tag tree hierarchy instead of at the root level.

## Customising Profinity

- [Component Reference](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/index.html): Reference for the dashboard components in four categories: layout, data display, content, and interactive.
- [Profinity Dashboard Development Guide](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/index.html): Guide to building data-driven dashboards in Profinity 2.3 with the visual editor, and to the dashboard YAML format behind them.
- [Hosting Custom Applications](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Hosting/index.html): Host a custom web application from Profinity's integrated web server, with optional HTTPS certificates.
- [Customising Profinity](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/index.html): Tailor how Profinity looks and behaves for a deployment with dashboards, theming, hosted web applications, and OEM white-label mobile builds.
- [Themes and Branding](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Theming/index.html): Customise Profinity appearance with themes, colours, logos, and light and dark mode support.
- [HTML Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Content/HTML.html): Embed custom HTML content with references to profile assets for rich text formatting and custom layouts, or show a map that follows a position.
- [Icon Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Content/Icon.html): Display an icon from the Carbon icon set or the profile images directory.
- [Redirect Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Content/Redirect.html): Immediately navigates to another page or address when the dashboard displays the component.
- [Caption Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/Caption.html): Text caption that shows a static string or a bound value.
- [Charts Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/Charts.html): Data visualisation component supporting line, bar, radar, pie, doughnut, bubble, scatter, and polar area charts.
- [Lamp Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/Lamp.html): Single colour-coded status indicator with a label, driven by a value, an enabled state and a colour.
- [Lamps Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/Lamps.html): Grid of colour-coded status indicators for quick system state visualisation and error/warning displays.
- [Log Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/Log.html): Scrolling log of engine messages, optionally filtered to the output of a single script.
- [Readouts Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/Readouts.html): Display numerical and text values with units, precision control, and data binding for sensor readings and measurements.
- [State Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/State.html): State machine visualisation component using Mermaid flowcharts to display system states and transitions.
- [Tables Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Data/Tables.html): Data table display with heatmap visualisation, highlighting, and value threshold alerts for multi-dimensional data.
- [Actions Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Interactive/Actions.html): Interactive buttons for triggering component actions, system actions, navigation or HTTP requests.
- [Image Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Interactive/Image.html): Interactive image component with clickable regions, icons, buttons, data values, points, and annotation lines.
- [Model Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Interactive/Model.html): Interactive 3D model component with clickable regions, icons, buttons, data values, points, and annotation lines in model space.
- [Tabs Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Interactive/Tabs.html): Tabbed interface with header lamps and body content for organising multiple data views.
- [Toggles Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Interactive/Toggles.html): Switch controls that run an action when clicked and show an on or off state from data.
- [Accordion Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Accordion.html): Collapsible sections for organising dashboard content that can be expanded and collapsed on demand.
- [Footer Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Footer.html): Bar at the bottom of a dashboard that the web interface shows or hides from a data binding, without displaying menu content.
- [Group Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Group.html): Container for organising related components in horizontal or vertical arrangement with flexible sizing.
- [Menu Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Menu.html): Menu structure used by the titlebar and side menu, with menu items, submenus, logos, toggles, dialogs and actions.
- [Panel Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Panel.html): Individual titled panel within a grid layout for organising related content and data visualisations.
- [Panels Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Panels.html): Grid layout of multiple panel containers for organising complex information into separate sections.
- [Pill Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Pill.html): Status pill with central icon and grouped readouts for compact component status and key metric display.
- [Row Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Row.html): Layout container for organising multiple components horizontally or vertically within dashboards.
- [Titlebar Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Component_Reference/Layout/Titlebar.html): Header bar of a dashboard with a status lamp and a toolbar of menu items for identification, navigation, actions and dialogs.
- [Conditional Styling](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Conditional_Styling.html): Dynamically change component appearance, visibility, and behaviour based on real-time data values.
- [Core Elements](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Core_Elements.html): The elements a dashboard holds at its top level (titlebar, row, accordion, footer), how items nest, and how rows lay out their contents.
- [Data Binding](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Data_Binding.html): Connect dashboard components to tags, and choose whether a binding shows the latest value, recent history or logged data.
- [Dashboard Examples](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Examples.html): Progressive examples from simple hello-world dashboards to complete real-world implementations.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/FAQ.html): Short answers to common questions about creating and configuring Profinity dashboards, with links to the pages that cover each topic.
- [Full Example](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Full_Example.html): Annotated real-world motor controller dashboard example with data binding and layout patterns.
- [Profile Directories](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Profile_Directories.html): Special profile directories for storing dashboard assets: images, 3D models, stylesheets, and content files, plus the other directories in a profile.
- [Troubleshooting Guide](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Troubleshooting.html): Diagnose and fix common dashboard issues including schema validation, data binding, and performance.
- [Dashboard Visual Editor](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Customising_Profinity/Dashboards/Visual_Editor.html): Build and change Profinity dashboards in the Profinity 2.3 visual editor: add widgets, arrange them in the component tree, and bind tags, with the YAML tab as a fallback.

## Integrating to Profinity

- [Profinity REST APIs](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Integrating_to_Profinity/APIs/index.html): Overview of Profinity's REST API architecture, security authentication with Bearer tokens, and accessing realtime and historical data.
- [Integrating to Profinity](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Integrating_to_Profinity/index.html): Connect other systems, applications, and AI assistants to Profinity using its REST APIs and MCP server.
- [MCP Server](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Integrating_to_Profinity/MCP_Server/index.html): Model Context Protocol server for AI assistants and MCP-aware tools to query live Profinity data.
- [Endpoint Reference](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Integrating_to_Profinity/APIs/Endpoint_Reference.html): REST API routes for alerts, collections, derived tags, Profinity AI chat, component and collection security, account resets, tag relay and themes.

## Developing with Profinity

- [Custom Components](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Custom_Components/index.html): Author a Custom Component from DBC, dashboard, script, action, and map files, and optionally pack it for another Profinity installation.
- [Developing with Profinity](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/index.html): Build on Profinity with scripting in C#, Python, or Lua, Custom Components, DLL plugins, and the Profinity SDK.
- [DLL Plugins](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Plugins/index.html): Build and package external DLL plugins against Profinity.Sdk.
- [Profinity Scripting](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/index.html): Scripting capabilities with C#, Python, and Lua for automation, CAN processing, and custom operations.
- [Supported Operations](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Operations/index.html): Available script operations including CAN bus, DBC, state management, and console output.
- [Script Types](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Types/index.html): Seven script execution modes including Run, Receive, Service, and event-driven triggers.
- [Supported Languages](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Supported_Languages/index.html): Scripting support for C#, Python (IronPython), and Lua (NLua) with full .NET framework access.
- [Component Pack CLI](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Custom_Components/Component_Pack_CLI.html): Command-line tool for validating, packing, and installing custom component bundles (YAML, scripts, and DBC files).
- [Component Types](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Custom_Components/Component_Types.html): Comparison of two Profinity extension models: Custom Components and DLL plugins.
- [CAN Bus](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Operations/CANBus.html): Script operations for sending, receiving, and working with CAN bus packets and data.
- [Console](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Operations/Console.html): Script operations for console output and logging messages to the Profinity log.
- [DBC](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Operations/DBC.html): Script operations for loading, parsing, and working with DBC files and CAN message definitions.
- [State](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Operations/State.html): Thread-safe state management for persistence between script invocations and inter-script communication.
- [Tags](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Operations/Tags.html): Script operations for reading, writing and describing tags in the Profinity tag tree.
- [Receive Scripts](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Types/ReceiveScripts.html): Scripts that automatically execute when matching CAN bus packets are received.
- [Rule Scripts](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Types/Rule_Scripts.html): Scripts set to Run On Alert mode that execute when rules fire with alert context.
- [Run Scripts](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Types/RunScripts.html): Flexible scripts executed manually on-demand or automatically on a schedule.
- [Service Scripts](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Types/ServiceScripts.html): Continuous, long-running scripts with service-like lifecycle management and event handling.
- [Tag Change Scripts](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/Scripting/Script_Types/TagChangeScripts.html): Scripts set to Run On Tag Change mode that execute each time a watched tag's value changes.
- [Profinity SDK](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Developing_with_Profinity/SDK.html): Developer kit including libraries, component pack CLI, and script tools for building extensions.

## CAN Utilities

- [CAN Bus DBC](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/CAN_Utilities/CAN_Bus_DBC.html): View and analyse CAN messages and signals using DBC files with text and numeric range filtering.
- [Log / Replay CAN](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/CAN_Utilities/Logging_Replaying_CAN_Bus_Messages.html): Log CAN bus messages to files and replay recorded logs with playback controls and timing options.
- [Send / Receive CAN](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/CAN_Utilities/Send_Receive_CAN_Bus_Messages.html): Monitor CAN bus traffic, send individual packets, and schedule periodic CAN message transmission.

## Mobile

- [Profinity Mobile](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Mobile/index.html): Connect to Profinity from iOS or Android with UDP server discovery, HTTPS support, and kiosk mode.
- [OEM White-Label Mobile Builds](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Mobile/OEM_White_Label.html): Build and distribute white-label Profinity Mobile apps with custom branding and bundle identifiers.

## Profinity AI

- [Profinity AI](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Profinity_AI/index.html): How Profinity AI uses the context of your whole Profile, through AI Chat inside Profinity and AI Skills in your own AI tool.
- [AI Chat](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Profinity_AI/AI_Chat.html): Query live instance data, search documentation, and get help through the integrated AI chat assistant.
- [AI Skills](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Profinity_AI/AI_Skills.html): Seven skills that let Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT build Profinity config and code, and act as a power-user alternative to AI Chat.

## How To Guides

- [How to Guides](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/index.html): Task-based guides for Profinity 2.3: dashboards, components, CAN bus, data logging, configuration, AI and scripting.
- [How to Add a Component to Your Profile](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Add_Component_to_Profile.html): Add and configure CAN bus components like Prohelion devices, adapters, and loggers to your Profinity profile.
- [How to Add Images to Your Dashboard](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Add_Images_to_Dashboard.html): Add custom images (SVG, PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF) to your Profinity dashboards by storing them in the images folder of the profile directory.
- [How to Configure Data Logging](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Configure_Data_Logging.html): Configure data logging to files, InfluxDB, Prometheus, MQTT brokers, or webhooks to capture CAN bus messages or tag values.
- [How to Connect Profinity to AI](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Connect_Profinity_to_AI.html): Connect Profinity to AI tools and MCP clients using the Profinity Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over Streamable HTTP with a bearer token.
- [How to Connect to CAN Bus](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Connect_to_CAN_Bus.html): Connect Profinity to your CAN bus network using supported adapters like Peak USB, SocketCAN, Ewert Energy CANdapter, or Prohelion and Tritium CAN to Ethernet bridges.
- [How to Create a Custom Component](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Create_Custom_Component.html): Add a Custom Component to a profile and attach an optional DBC file, dashboard, script, and actions.
- [How to Create a Custom Dashboard](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Create_Custom_Dashboard.html): Create a custom dashboard for a Profinity component in the visual editor, binding tags to display real-time component data, with the YAML tab as a fallback.
- [How to Create a New Profile](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Create_New_Profile.html): Create new Profinity profiles to manage different configurations for different setups, locations, or testing scenarios.
- [How to Create a Profile Dashboard](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Create_Profile_Dashboard.html): Create a custom dashboard in the visual editor to replace the default Profinity home page for your profile, or upload a YAML file instead.
- [How to Debug Dashboard Issues](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Debug_Dashboard_Issues.html): Find and fix common dashboard problems: a dashboard that does not load, readouts that show no data, images that do not appear, and styles that are not applied.
- [How to Log Data to the Cloud (InfluxDB)](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Log_Data_to_Cloud_Influx.html): Configure Profinity to log CAN bus data to InfluxDB Cloud or self-hosted for cloud-based analytics and visualisation.
- [How to Replay CAN Bus Logs](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Replay_CAN_Logs.html): Replay recorded CAN bus messages from log files to test your Profinity system without live CAN hardware.
- [How to Send and Receive CAN Bus Messages](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Send_Receive_CAN_Bus.html): Send and receive CAN bus messages using Profinity's built-in tools for manual and scheduled packet transmission.
- [How to Set Up Profinity as a Kiosk Application](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Set_Up_Profinity_as_Kiosk.html): Configure Profinity to run as a kiosk application that auto-launches in fullscreen mode on Windows, Linux, or macOS.
- [How to Style Your Dashboard](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Style_Dashboard.html): Apply custom CSS styling to Profinity dashboard elements for branding and visual customisation.
- [How to View Dashboard Source](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/View_Dashboard_Source.html): Access the YAML source code of existing dashboards to learn from examples and create custom dashboard modifications.
- [How to Write Your First Script](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/Write_Your_First_Script.html): Write your first Profinity script in C# or Python to automate tasks and interact with CAN bus components.

## Release Notes

- [Release Notes](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Release_Notes/index.html): Browse release notes for Profinity V2 versions including 2.3 and 2.2.5 with key features and upgrade information.
- [Profinity 2.2.5](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Release_Notes/2.2.5.html): Release notes for Profinity 2.2.5 covering artefact directory migration, dashboard validation, CAN adapter reliability, and BMS updates.
- [Profinity 2.3.1](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Release_Notes/2.3.1.html): Release notes for Profinity 2.3: editions and licensing, Profinity AI, derived tags, publishers and subscribers, role-based security, REST error changes, and how to upgrade from 2.2.

## Overview

- [Prohelion Profinity 2.3](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/index.html): Profinity 2.3, a CAN bus and industrial data management platform that connects industrial equipment and vehicles to AI tools, cloud services, APIs and big data analytics.
